strings.subtitle: — Jeļā peij —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Ejjelok iten im kōm̧m̧an. Kōjerbal bok in lal̗o.
strings.shred_button: K A J E Ļ Ā
strings.ssd_warning:
Kōjatdikdik! Ioon SSD, ejjelok kōm̧m̧an kein jeļā kin TRIM.
Peij in ej ñan HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Peij eo "{name}" enaaj jerrā im kōm̧m̧an.

Etal?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
In shortcut (.lnk). Shortcut wōt naj destroy.

Target file naj bed intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
In network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite ejjeļo̧k guarantee — server maroñ snapshot, deduplication ak CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
In removable drive (USB / HDD external).
Controller maroñ keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_title: ✅  PEIJ EO AR JERRĀ IM AR KŌM̧M̧AN
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS ial in melele (ADS) ejjelok jerbal.
• USN bok ejjelok kōm̧m̧an.
• Pija kopi im ao sync
  (OneDrive im bar) ejjelok kōm̧m̧an.
strings.status_full: Melele ko ar jerrā ñan jiro aolep. Ejjelok kōm̧m̧an — kein lo pija jiro wōt.
strings.status_fast: Bōran, jikin im 4 MB iaļ ar jerrā. To eo ejjelok kōm̧m̧an, ak kin jikin, jab kōm̧m̧an kein lo pija otemjeļo̧k. Ñan bok in letok, kōjerbal IAAR KŌM̧M̧AN.
strings.status_empty: Peij eo ear ijjelo̧k, jerrā ioon ejjelok aikuj. Ar kōm̧m̧an.
strings.error_permission: Ejjeļo̧k access pej. Maroñ open ilo program jet. Close im try again.
strings.error_is_symlink: In symbolic link. Links ejjeļo̧k destroy — target file naj bed intact.
strings.error_reparse: In placeholder pej (OneDrive ak similar). Data ej bed ilo cloud, ejjeļo̧k disk — ejjeļo̧k destroy here.
strings.error_not_file: In ejjeļo̧k pej (folder ak jet). Drop pej.
strings.error_hardlinks: Pej in ejjeļo̧k hard link jet ({n} total). Hard link ejjeļo̧k primary — aolep etan equal. Ñe kwōj destroy via current path, data naj overwrite im truncate ñan 32 bytes, ak stub naj accessable via link jet. Delete aolep links ṃokta.
strings.error_compressed:
Pej compressed, encrypted ak sparse. Zero overwrite ejjeļo̧k guarantee destroy old data bwe NTFS ej store differently.

Remove attribute: right-click → Properties → Advanced → uncheck 'Compress' im/ak 'Encrypt'. Ālikar run SHREDDER again.
strings.queue_confirm_text:
{count} pej naaj destroy.
Aetōl: {size}.

Lale list ṃokta jān continue.
Action in ejjeļo̧k an kōjjeḷā.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Remove {count} pej jān queue?

Pej ko REJ NAJ TOUCH — list wōt.
strings.hardlink_text:
Pej "{name}" ejjeļo̧k hard link ({nlink} total).

Data naj destroy ñan aolep etan.
Ak stub (32 bytes) naj bed ñan etan jet ilo folder.

Kwomaroñ delete stubs in manually.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Apply ñan aolep hard link ilo queue
